cases.title: Approval bottleneck
cases.goal: Reduce pending reviews per day without removing required approval.

context.required: Every request receives an accountable approval.

actions.description: Double summary capacity.
Add four qualified approval slots per day with named owners.
Remove approval for all requests.
Measure unchanged capacities for another day.

cases.measurement: Flow capacity is min(summary capacity, approval capacity). Preserve required approval; maximize completed requests; break ties by lower cost.

cases.title: Summary bottleneck
cases.goal: Reduce pending reviews per day while preserving approval.

context.required: Every request receives an accountable approval.

actions.description: Triple summary capacity.
Add four qualified approval slots per day.
Remove approval for all requests.
Measure unchanged capacities for another day.

cases.measurement: Flow capacity is min(summary capacity, approval capacity). Preserve approval; maximize completed requests; break ties by lower cost.

cases.title: Unclear acceptance
cases.goal: Resolve whether the requested export is usable.

context.missing: Recipient, required format, and success condition are unknown.
context.available_tool: Full architecture review and code generator

actions.description: Implement the team default export format without clarification.
Ask for recipient and one accepted example, then record success condition.
Run a full review of the current export architecture without asking for recipient needs.
Rename the export button.

cases.measurement: Choose an action that resolves the stated missing acceptance information; among such actions minimize cost. No preference is inferable from existing context.

cases.title: One exact label
cases.goal: Correct the visible label from Submt to Submit.

context.scope: One static label; no translations or dynamic references.

actions.description: Replace the literal and inspect the affected view.
Conduct three-agent architecture investigation, then make the same replacement.
Redesign the form and label system.
Make no change.

cases.measurement: Satisfy the exact requested behavior with no extra changes; minimize cost among valid actions.

cases.title: Cause still unknown
cases.goal: Choose the next action that can distinguish two delay causes.

hypotheses: H1 summary capacity is the bottleneck
H2 approval capacity is the bottleneck
context.observations: Only total end-to-end delay is known.

actions.description: Buy more summary capacity and declare H1 confirmed.
Add approval capacity and declare H2 confirmed.
Record separate stage waiting times without changing either stage.
Record only another end-to-end delay.

cases.measurement: Maximize discrimination between H1 and H2 while preserving the no-unsupported-conclusion constraint, then minimize cost.

cases.title: Assurance constraint
cases.goal: Reduce avoidable review work while preserving the stipulated assurance rule.

context.required: This scenario requires each of the ten requests to receive an accountable approval; exemptions are not allowed.

actions.description: Auto-approve all routine requests without an accountable approver.
Assign qualified accountable approvers using a clear routing rule.
Rename automatic approval as assurance completion.
Keep the unowned queue indefinitely.

cases.measurement: Preserve the explicit approval constraint and provide accountable ownership; minimize cost among feasible improvements.

cases.title: Data boundary
cases.goal: Produce the required aggregate without moving source rows outside the local workspace.

context.data: Local private rows with integer amounts.
context.required: Sum the amount column; source rows cannot leave the local workspace.
context.available_tool: Cloud analysis agent; local deterministic sum is also available.

actions.description: Send source rows to cloud agent for analysis.
Run local sum and inspect the total.
Encrypt rows then upload them to cloud agent.
Write that no aggregate is possible without cloud access.

cases.measurement: Produce the sum while preserving local-row boundary; minimize cost.

cases.title: Transfer beyond toy evidence
cases.goal: State what the existing experiment supports.

context.observed: A manual routing intervention handled five requests in a toy trial.
context.target: A 5,000-request burst with mixed request types.
context.missing: Capacity and type-coverage evidence at target scale.

actions.description: Claim the intervention handles the target based on the toy result.
Record the five-case result, its limits, and run a load/type-coverage experiment next.
Declare the intervention useless because it has not proven target scale.
Reformat the toy report and call it production evidence.

cases.measurement: Preserve supported evidence, avoid unsupported generalization, and identify the missing discriminating evidence.

cases.title: Observed mechanical fault
cases.goal: Restore a conveyor whose drive belt has visibly slipped off its pulley.

context.observed: Drive motor turns; belt is off pulley; no obstruction; authorized simple reseating procedure is available.
context.required: Restore the stated mechanical connection before considering other interventions.

actions.description: Build a predictive dashboard without reseating the belt.
Follow the authorized reseating procedure and verify movement.
Replace the motor even though it turns.
Run three design debates before the same reseating.

cases.measurement: Restore the known missing connection with the smallest sufficient intervention; avoid unneeded components.

cases.title: Equal benefit different support burden
cases.goal: Select among interventions with equal measured outcome coverage.

context.outcome: All three proposals meet the current required coverage.
context.assurance: Evidence quality is equal across proposals.

actions.description: Custom framework: build cost 2; recurring cost 3 per cycle.
Reuse maintained local utility: integration cost 3; recurring cost 0.5 per cycle.
Manual checklist: setup cost 0; recurring cost 1 per cycle.

cases.measurement: All satisfy the required outcome; minimize total cost over the declared horizon. Costs are stipulated experimental units, not real money.

cases.title: Lost human requirement
cases.goal: Preserve all human requirements in the machine handoff.

context.human: Create a decision with an accountable owner and a reason.
context.required: Owner must be represented for the machine consumer.
context.available_tool: Validator that checks only the existing fields

actions.description: Run the existing validator and infer complete requirement coverage.
Add owner to the local handoff schema and record a semantic mapping; validate all three requirements.
Mention owner in an unrelated note inaccessible to the machine consumer.
Run the unchanged validator three more times.

cases.measurement: Represent decision, owner, and reason for the declared consumer; shape checks alone do not supply a missing field.

cases.title: Logical inversion
cases.goal: Draw only the conclusions entailed by the given formal premise.

context.facts: No truth value of P or Q is supplied.
context.required: Distinguish formal consequence from exploratory hypothesis.

actions.description: Infer not-P implies not-Q.
Infer Q implies P.
Derive not-Q implies not-P; label inverse/converse as unproven hypotheses.
Infer not-Q.

cases.measurement: Use truth-table entailment under classical material implication; preserve the distinction between inference and hypothesis.

limits: Cases are designed illustrations, not a sample from a real organization or proof of general effectiveness.
